##### Project general facts

Volantè by Zoya is a boutique residential building conceived as a calm place to come home to with room for family life and everyday needs close by. The low-rise architecture is defined by curved white balconies, warm façade tones and a sculpted canopy crowning the roof, while landscaped frontage and palm-lined walkways soften the arrival. The collection comprises studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom residences with practical layouts that balance family time and privacy.

Residents enjoy a resort-style setting designed for every age. Adults' and kids' pools sit alongside a gym and a yoga and relaxation area, while a kids' play area and a barbecue area bring families and neighbours together. Landscaped gardens and outdoor seating create quiet corners to step outside, gather and recharge without leaving home.

Every residence is delivered fully furnished and thoughtfully styled, so homes are ready to live in from the very first day. Interiors combine soft textures, deep tones and refined finishes, giving each apartment a warm and welcoming character that suits both owner-occupiers and those looking for a move-in-ready investment.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a district growing around Al Maktoum International Airport, bringing together residential communities and workplaces within one connected area. The district sits close to Expo City Dubai.

Schools, supermarkets and workplaces are found within the district, and Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road provide quick access to the rest of the city. Expo City Dubai and its metro station, Dubai Parks and Resorts, The Outlet Village and Jebel Ali Free Zone are all within a short drive, with Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai reachable by road.

The expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport brings new jobs, new communities and lasting demand to the area. With homes, schools and employment in the same district, Dubai South appeals to end users and investors looking for long-term growth.
